annotations.title: Use my synced bets on my public record

description: Turn on (consent true) or off (default) the use of this account’s connected-sportsbook bets on its public record, with a unique commandKey. On: posted picks settle from the connected sportsbook, and the results and units show on the profile, posts and the Top list. Off: posts settle from final scores or the account’s own marks only. Separate from Show my record. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.
name: set_synced_record_consent
title: Use my synced bets on my public record
